workloads.label: aql-mix@1
workloads.description: Query speed over one population, one set of percentiles per query class rather than one blended query number: the indexed point lookup, the single-EHR scan, the value filter, the cross-EHR population filter, the population COUNT, and the ordered page a paged interface reads.
workloads.reproduces: The aql-mix bench pack, version 1.1.0: 50 EHRs each holding the community harness's Vital signs composition 20 times, seeded on 8 workers, and six AQL classes offered open-loop at equal shares.

interactions.description: One COUNT over the population the threshold matches.
interactions.derivation: The pack's aggregate class, at an equal sixth.

interactions.name: aql_ehr_scan
interactions.description: Every composition in one EHR, projected by uid.
interactions.derivation: The pack's EHR-scan class, at an equal sixth.

interactions.name: aql_filtered
interactions.description: A systolic threshold over one EHR's observations.
interactions.derivation: The pack's filtered class, at an equal sixth.

interactions.name: aql_ordered_page
interactions.description: An ORDER BY over composition start time, read one page at a time.
interactions.derivation: The pack's ordered-page class, at an equal sixth.

interactions.name: aql_point_lookup
interactions.description: One composition addressed by its uid inside one EHR.
interactions.derivation: The pack's point-lookup class, at the equal share it gives each of six.

interactions.name: aql_population
interactions.description: The systolic threshold across the population, fetch-bounded.
interactions.derivation: The pack's population class, at an equal sixth.

queries.name: aql_aggregate
queries.text: SELECT COUNT(c/uid/value) FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic
queries.description: One COUNT over the population a systolic threshold matches.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's aggregate class, one row that reads every value behind it.

queries.name: aql_ehr_scan
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
queries.description: Every composition in one EHR, projected by uid.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's EHR-scan class, whose cost follows how much the EHR holds.

queries.name: aql_filtered
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic
queries.description: A systolic threshold over the observations of one EHR.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's filtered class, the value index with a drawn threshold.

queries.name: aql_ordered_page
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value, c/context/start_time/value FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC
queries.description: Compositions ordered by start time, one page at a time.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's ordered-page class, the shape a paged user interface issues (QUERY AQL master03-syntax.adoc §ORDER BY).

queries.name: aql_point_lookup
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c WHERE c/uid/value = $uid
queries.description: One composition addressed by its own uid inside one EHR.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's point-lookup class, the indexed-read floor.

queries.name: aql_population
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic
queries.description: The systolic threshold with no EHR scope, bounded by a fetch count.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's population class, the cross-EHR planner.

workloads.label: clinical-mix@1
workloads.description: A hospital front end at its busy hour: clinicians opening charts (a partly-open session of subject lookup, summary query, document reads and an observation trend), ward boards and problem lists polling AQL, the monitoring, order, result and correction writes of ward work, and the definition, folder, tag, demographic and bootstrap traffic around them. Carried over from the 24 journeys of perf/journeys.yaml without their minute-scale offsets. Provisional, for SEC ratification.

queries.text: SELECT COUNT(c/uid/value) FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic

queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's EHR-scan class, whose cost follows how much the EHR holds.

queries.name: aql_filtered
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic

queries.name: aql_ordered_page
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value, c/context/start_time/value FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC
queries.description: Compositions ordered by start time, one page at a time.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's ordered-page class, the shape a paged user interface issues (QUERY AQL master03-syntax.adoc §ORDER BY).

queries.name: aql_point_lookup
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c WHERE c/uid/value = $uid

queries.name: aql_population
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic
queries.description: The systolic threshold with no EHR scope, bounded by a fetch count.
queries.derivation: The aql-mix bench pack's population class, the cross-EHR planner.

queries.name: cohort_count
queries.text: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e/ehr_id/value) AS patients FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude >= $systolic
queries.description: How many patients have a systolic reading at or above a threshold.
queries.derivation: QUERY AQL master03-syntax.adoc §COUNT ("COUNT([DISTINCT] expression|*)") over the population, the cohort question a service-line dashboard asks.

queries.name: observation_trend
queries.text: SELECT o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude AS systolic, o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0005]/value/magnitude AS diastolic, c/context/start_time/value AS start_time FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 10
queries.description: The patient's latest blood-pressure readings, newest first.
queries.derivation: QUERY AQL_examples master04-single_subject.adoc, the latest blood pressure values of one patient, over the blood_pressure.v2 archetype the vital-signs template carries.

queries.name: patient_summary
queries.text: SELECT c/uid/value AS uid, c/name/value AS name, c/context/start_time/value AS start_time FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 20
queries.description: The patient's latest documents by name and start time.
queries.derivation: The summary list a chart opens on; the ordered, limited shape of QUERY AQL master03-syntax.adoc §LIMIT. The transport split follows ITS-REST docs/query/Request.md §GET vs POST, which recommends POST for long queries, with the stored half of a front end's registered queries.

queries.name: problem_list
queries.text: SELECT ev/data[at0001]/items[at0002]/value/value AS problem, c/context/start_time/value AS recorded FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS EVALUATION ev[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1]
queries.description: The patient's recorded problems and diagnoses.
queries.derivation: The problem list a front end shows, over the problem_diagnosis.v1 archetype the IPS and GP data set templates carry.

queries.name: problem_list_terminology
queries.text: SELECT ev/data[at0001]/items[at0002]/value/value AS problem FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehr_uid] CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS EVALUATION ev[openEHR-EHR-EVALUATION.problem_diagnosis.v1] WHERE ev/data[at0001]/items[at0002]/value/defining_code/code_string matches TERMINOLOGY('expand', 'hl7.org/fhir/r4', 'url=http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs=isa/404684003')
queries.description: The patient's problems that fall under SNOMED CT clinical finding.
queries.derivation: QUERY AQL master03-syntax.adoc §TERMINOLOGY and AQL_examples master03-syntax-function.adoc §TERMINOLOGY Example 1 (expand a value set); the release leaves the terminology server to the implementation, which catalogue/capabilities.yaml records as the aql-terminology option.

queries.name: ward_board
queries.text: SELECT e/ehr_id/value AS ehr_id, c/uid/value AS uid, o/data[at0001]/events[at0006]/data[at0003]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude AS systolic FROM EHR e CONTAINS COMPOSITION c CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.blood_pressure.v2] WHERE e/ehr_id/value matches {$bed_1, $bed_2, $bed_3, $bed_4, $bed_5, $bed_6, $bed_7, $bed_8} ORDER BY c/context/start_time/value DESC LIMIT 50
queries.description: The latest systolic reading of each of eight beds.
queries.derivation: perf/journeys.yaml ward_dashboard, the registered stored query a dashboard polls; a list of EHRs is a multi-patient query, so it carries no EHR scope (ITS-REST docs/query/Request.md §About the ehr_id parameter).

workloads.label: community-vitals@1
workloads.description: The community harness's population and read walk, labelled closed-loop as the harness runs them, followed by the same seven reads at equal shares as Poisson arrivals on the load ladder, which is where latency is measured from the instant each read was due. Carried over from the community-vitals bench pack, version 1.1.0.
workloads.reproduces: The openEHR community's vital-signs benchmark harness (https://discourse.openehr.org/t/17224): 100 EHRs, the Vital signs composition of post 8 committed 1,000 times into each on one worker, then a sequential walk of seven reads over every committed composition.

interactions.name: read_at_time

interactions.derivation: The harness's second read, at an equal seventh.

interactions.name: read_latest

interactions.derivation: The harness's first read, at the equal share its walk gives each of seven.

interactions.name: read_revision_history
interactions.description: The revision history, which walks every version of the object.
interactions.derivation: The harness's seventh read, at an equal seventh.

interactions.name: read_version_at_time
interactions.description: The version at an instant through the versioned object.
interactions.derivation: The harness's fifth read, at an equal seventh.

interactions.description: One version by its own identifier.
interactions.derivation: The harness's sixth read, at an equal seventh.

interactions.name: read_version_latest
interactions.description: The latest version through the versioned object.
interactions.derivation: The harness's fourth read, at an equal seventh.

interactions.name: read_versioned
interactions.description: The VERSIONED_COMPOSITION container itself.
interactions.derivation: The harness's third read, at an equal seventh.
